3M.event: Spun off its entire Health Care business (including its advanced wound care and NPWT lines) into a standalone independent company named Solventum Corporation.
3M.evidence: 3M completed the spin-off of its health care and advanced wound care division into an independent publicly traded company named Solventum Corporation on April 1, 2024. Solventum now manages and offers the V.A.C. Therapy lines of negative pressure wound therapy systems. Source: 3M Company Press Releases and SEC Stock Exchange Filings.

Direct Healthcare Group.event: merged with Invacare Europe/APAC to form DHCare
Direct Healthcare Group.evidence: Direct Healthcare Group operates from Caerphilly, UK and provides the Venturi Negative Pressure Wound Therapy system. In 2026, it was acquired by Rhône Group and merged with Invacare Europe and Asia Pacific to form DHCare.

Weihai Medison Medical Equipment Co., Lt.evidence: According to the official website, Weihai Medison Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. operates under its international brand VEMERIX, offering medical vacuum NPWT pumps and disposable drainage dressings. The platform confirms active operations with corporate copyright dating up to 2026.
